summary: The base reproduced exactness failures from threshold-bin overflow. The exact candidate passed its regression suite and independent overflow/adversarial cases on gfx950. Its CUDA-only cluster disable directly removes the known source dispatch, but the original CUDA/B200 path could not be compiled or executed on this ROCm-only host.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base value-multiset exactness versus torch.topk. The 2049-candidate boundary had 11 mismatches; larger overflow cases had 1867-2048 mismatches, with no invalid or duplicate outputs.
Exact candidate value-multiset exactness for boundary, register, streaming, original N=262144, two-value, and exact-tie cases; all mismatches were zero on gfx950.
Independent adversarial value-multiset checks for k=512/1024/2048, shuffled bands, negative values, mixed batches, subnormals, and signed-zero ties; all mismatches were zero.
Candidate regression and surrounding top-k v2 coverage: 289 passed.
CUDA compiler availability; none was present.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests executed on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

native_rebuilt.evidence: Fresh private base-jit and candidate-jit caches compiled the repository JIT C++/HIP sources and candidate tests executed the rebuilt candidate library. CUDA native code was not built because nvcc/CUDA hardware were unavailable.

remaining_counterexamples: The original batch=1, N=262144 B200 fixture and CUDA TopKStreaming fallback have not been runtime-verified on CUDA hardware.
CUDA compilation of the candidate's changed native headers was not verified because nvcc is unavailable.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA B200/CUDA device, nvcc toolchain, GLM-5.2 weights, reported real score dumps, TP8, or multi-node environment was available.
The candidate disables the CUDA cluster path globally; correctness is source-supported, but CUDA runtime behavior and the possible long-row/small-batch performance regression remain unmeasured.
